messages:
alex (sec): We're planning to remove CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_NET_ADMIN, CAP_NET_RAW and strip setuid from base images. Need a short rollout checklist: discovery, RBAC/KMS signing, audit logs, admission gating, rollback. Suggestions?
mike (infra): Start with inventory. Two quick checks: pods with added caps and images with suid files. Kubectl snippet for caps: `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name} {.spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add}\n{end}' | grep -v "<none>"`. For suid, run a privileged DaemonSet that runs `find / -perm /4000 -type f -print`. Run in staging first.
tara (eng-runtime): For admission gating, deploy Gatekeeper/OPA in audit mode for 2 weeks, alert on violations, then switch to deny with a limited escape/whitelist namespace. Keep rollout steps: inventory -> audit -> rebuild+sign -> canary -> enforce.
sylvie (platform): KMS/signing: recommend per-team keys (reduce blast radius), grant build SA `cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign` (or cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner), and enable Data Access audit logs for keys (off by default). Use Workload Identity for auth; avoid long-lived JSON keys. I can make a TF module for keys + IAM + logging sink.
alex (sec): Key rotation: quarterly or after major rebase, and run automated re-sign for prod images. Also require signing logs to include image name, digest, and builder SA.
mike (infra): I'll run the cluster scan and post results. If we find >5 production workloads depending on caps, we'll pause and coordinate manual mitigations.
audit-bot: SEC-811 created and assigned to mike (infra), due 2024-10-30.
sylvie (platform): I'll open the TF PR and include instructions for enabling DATA_ACCESS audit logs.
tara (eng-runtime): I'll prepare a small resign job and the Gatekeeper policy (audit mode) for staging.
alex (sec): Great. Action items: mike: inventory; sylvie: TF PR; tara: gatekeeper+resign script; I'll own final enforcement decision. Keep updates on SEC-811. :thumbsup:
